milestones.task: till dirt into farmland with hoe
milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_least(kind='block', object='farmland', min_count=1) because tilling dirt with a hoe converts the dirt block into a farmland block in-place. We check for at least one farmland block within a generous box (±5 XZ, Y from -2 to 0) around spawn, which fully covers the 9x9 dirt platform placed at Y=-1 relative to spawn. This rule type is preferred for place/build/transform tasks where a block state change is the observable outcome.
